description:
Regional Arbok continues the grey Normal/Dark snake line, retaining its recognizable hood and markings. Its visual familiarity matters more than decorative redesign; its altered typing is not a story about corruption.

Continues the regional Dark move substitutions and stock battle proportions; no new wild Arbok placement is implied.

Proposed raising continuity: the larger body needs a wider exit and can no longer disappear into the small gaps used as Ekans. A companion first draws its coils away from a passing person, then spreads its hood if repeatedly crowded. The warning should be readable before battle rather than appearing as an unexplained ambush. Its caretaker learns to leave it room to withdraw; commanding aggression is not the only way to live with an intimidating animal.
